headline: Approved site plan for 10 & 12 Industrial Drive and condo conversion at 36 Pillsbury Road; a 16 and 22 Delta Drive motion failed.
summary: Rockpoint Commons at 225 Rockingham Road received a 60-day extension, to November 4, 2026. A subdivision of Map 10 Lot 42 on Pillsbury Road into three residential lots was conditionally approved. Staff raised traffic concerns about the Nouria entrance at Simms Drive and Rockingham Road.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 5, 2026 meeting, 7-0-1.
Approved the minutes of the August 12, 2026 meeting, 6-0-2.
Approved a 60-day extension of the conditional site plan for Rockpoint Commons at 225 Rockingham Road, to November 4, 2026, 8-0-0.
Motion to accept the lot line adjustment application for 16 and 22 Delta Drive as complete failed, 4-4-0.
Accepted the site plan application for 10 & 12 Industrial Drive as complete, waiving the traffic report for acceptance purposes only, 8-0-0.
Granted a waiver from LSPR 3.10.3.2 for locating and identifying trees 12 inches in caliper or greater, 8-0-0.
Granted conditional approval of the site plan for 10 & 12 Industrial Drive, 8-0-0.
Accepted the Map 10 Lot 42 subdivision and lot line application as complete for acceptance purposes only, 8-0-0.
Granted a partial waiver regarding the placement of a monument, 8-0-0.
Granted conditional approval of the subdivision of Map 10 Lot 42 into three residential lots, 8-0-0.
Accepted the condo conversion application at 36 Pillsbury Road as complete, 8-0-0.
Approved the condo conversion at 36 Pillsbury Road, 8-0-0.

decision_evidence.quote: A. Rugg made a motion to approve the minutes of August 5, 2026, as presented. J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 7-0-1, with J. Knights abstaining.
A. Rugg made a motion to approve the minutes of August 12, 2026, as presented. J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 6-0-2, with J. Knights and J. Farrell abstaining.

J. Farrell made a motion to grant a 60-day extension of the conditional site plan for approval for Rockpoint Commons, 225 Rockingham Road, Tax Map 15 Lot 126, to November 4, 2026. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell made a motion to accept the application as complete for acceptance purposes only, and any outstanding checklist items would be addressed as a condition of approval. G. Verani seconded the motion. The motion failed 4-4-0, with A. Chiampa, T. DeFrancesco, A. Rugg, and J. Knights voting in opposition.

A. Rugg made a motion to accept the application as complete and to waive the traffic report for acceptance purposes only, which would turn into a condition of approval. J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to grant a waiver from LSPR 3.10.3.2 ... J. Knights seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

A. Rugg made a motion to grant conditional approval of a site plan to expand and reconfigure trailer parking areas, installation of security fencing and controlled access gates, construction of a mobile loading dock area and associated site improvements. J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell made a motion to accept the application as complete for acceptance purposes only, and any outstanding checklist items will be part of a condition of approval. J. Knights seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to grant the partial waiver with regards to the monument. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell made a motion to grant conditional approval on the application for formal review of the subdivision and lot line adjustment of Map 10 Lot 42 into three residential lots ... The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to accept the application as complete. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to grant approval of a condo conversion of existing Map 10 Lot 42-2. 36 Pillsbury Road ... The motion carried 8-0-0.

decision_titles: 60-day extension for Rockpoint Commons, 225 Rockingham Road
Lot line adjustment at 16 and 22 Delta Drive
Subdivision of Map 10 Lot 42 on Pillsbury Road
Subdivision of Map 10 Lot 42 into three residential lots
